topics.title: Filesystem Hierarchy & File Navigation (pwd, ls, cd, cat, less)
topics.objective: Navigate the Unix FHS, understand absolute vs relative paths, and inspect file contents.
topics.exercise: Navigate system directories, create a nested directory tree, and inspect hidden configuration files.

topics.title: File Operations & Manipulation (cp, mv, rm, mkdir, touch)
topics.objective: Safely create, copy, move, and remove files and directories with confirmation flags.
topics.exercise: Organize an unorganized downloads directory into categorized folders using wildcard matching.

topics.title: Users, Groups & File Permissions (chmod, chown, sudo)
topics.objective: Understand read, write, and execute bits in octal (755, 644) and symbolic notation.
topics.exercise: Secure a script file so only the owner can read and execute it while denying all group access.

topics.title: Standard Streams, Pipes & Redirection (|, >, >>, grep, cut, sort)
topics.objective: Chain command outputs through pipelines to filter, transform, and aggregate text data.
topics.example: cat access.log | grep " 404 " | cut -d' ' -f7 | sort | uniq -c
topics.exercise: Extract the top 5 most frequently failing IP addresses from a sample server log file.

topics.title: Process Management & System Monitoring (ps, top, kill, systemctl)
topics.objective: Inspect running system processes, manage background jobs with & and fg, and control systemd units.
topics.exercise: Launch a background script, monitor its memory consumption, and terminate it cleanly.
